summary: The global marketing team is executing a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and managing a cluster of high-stakes content and event deliverables due this week.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the SEO/AI-search strategy, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as flagship programs; Joseph must draft the target audience and search prompts document, and the team needs to analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads to inform targeting. This week also demands finalizing the knowledge website redesign—Joseph to share his HTML file and schedule a feedback meeting, Joker to implement changes, and the team to incorporate BCI/BSI indices and integrate videos into topics. Several time-sensitive items require immediate attention: Ira must combine comments into the final ESG report draft, the team must discuss the 2027 SEO/GEO/SEM and third-party costs proposal early next week, and logistics for the Nov 27 Cartier Women's Initiative roundtable must be supported. Upcoming deliverables include publishing the MBZUAI Academy thank-you piece, adding video screenshots to the anniversary page, reviewing the Women in Leadership Forum emcee script, and promoting Asia Start videos and LinkedIn posts. Additionally, the team should resolve the Outlook account lockout issue by refreshing passwords across devices and confirming backend access with CKGSB.
